name: Exp_2pbIdealMA_ReOpen
summary: This EA trades based on the 2pbIdealMA indicator, entering positions when price crosses the ideal moving average line. It features a ReOpen mechanism that adds to winning positions on pullbacks to the MA, aiming to pyramid into strong trends while using the MA as dynamic support/resistance.
summary_zh: 该EA基于2pbIdealMA指标交易，在价格穿越理想均线时入场。其ReOpen机制在价格回踩至均线时加仓，旨在强势趋势中金字塔式加仓，同时以均线作为动态支撑/阻力。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是利用2pbIdealMA指标判断趋势方向，当价格突破均线时建立初始仓位。ReOpen机制是该EA的特色功能，在已有持仓盈利且价格回踩至均线附近时再次开仓加码，实现趋势中的金字塔加仓。入场条件包括价格与均线的交叉关系以及趋势方向的确认。出场依赖反向穿越均线或止损止盈设置，均线本身作为动态止损参考。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的方式，加仓时有独立的风控逻辑。资金管理方面需要注意多次加仓后的总仓位集中度风险，若趋势反转可能造成较大回撤。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses the 2pbIdealMA indicator to determine trend direction, establishing initial positions when price crosses the moving average line. The ReOpen mechanism is the EA's distinctive feature, adding to positions when price pulls back to the MA line while existing trades are in profit, implementing a pyramiding approach during trends. Entry conditions involve price-MA crossover relationships and trend direction confirmation. Exit relies on opposite-side MA crossover or stop-loss/take-profit settings, with the MA itself serving as a dynamic stop reference. Position sizing uses fixed lots or balance-proportional methods, with independent risk logic for re-entries. Money management requires attention to total position concentration after multiple add-ons, as trend reversals can cause significant drawdowns.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: ReOpen
parameters.description: 是否启用回踩加仓功能

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，0为不启用

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号码，用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: ReOpen加仓机制能在趋势行情中最大化盈利，利用回踩加码而非追涨
基于均线跟踪趋势，逻辑清晰易懂，参数可调性强
设有最大加仓次数限制，避免无限加仓导致过度集中风险
pros_en: The ReOpen mechanism maximizes profit in trending markets by adding on pullbacks rather than chasing
MA-based trend following is logically clear and easy to understand with highly adjustable parameters
Maximum re-open count limit prevents unlimited position accumulation and over-concentration risk
cons: 趋势反转时多重加仓会造成叠加损失，回撤可能较大
默认止损为0存在风险，未设置止损时亏损可能无限扩大
缺乏波动率过滤机制，在震荡市中可能频繁开仓并产生连续亏损
cons_en: Multiple pyramided positions can cause compounding losses during trend reversals with significant drawdowns
Default StopLoss of 0 is risky, as unlimited losses can occur without stop-loss protection
Lacks volatility filtering, potentially generating frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
improvements: 增加波动率过滤器(如ATR)，在低波动震荡行情中减少交易频率
加入基于ATR的动态止损和移动止损，替代固定点数止损
增加总仓位最大风险限制，确保多次加仓后总风险在可控范围内
improvements_en: Add a volatility filter (e.g., ATR) to reduce trading frequency during low-volatility ranging conditions
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and trailing stop instead of fixed pip values
Add maximum total position risk limit to ensure cumulative risk from multiple re-opens stays controlled

risk_points: 默认止损为0，趋势反转时可能造成重大亏损
多次加仓后仓位集中度高，单一趋势反转可导致大回撤
缺乏震荡市过滤，横盘时可能反复亏损开仓
risk_points_en: Default StopLoss of 0 can cause major losses during trend reversals
High position concentration after multiple re-opens can lead to large drawdowns on single trend reversal
No range market filter, potentially generating repeated losing entries during sideways consolidation

It features a ReOpen mechanism that adds to winning positions on pullbacks to the MA, aiming to pyramid into strong trends while using the MA as dynamic support/resistance.
